verdict.rationale: The pack shows no official SDK libraries for Perplexity Computer, but it does document programmatic surfaces to build against. These are an official hosted MCP server, live-verified with OAuth discovery, plus a REST Analytics API with an API reference and a published OpenAPI spec. Developers can integrate through MCP clients or raw HTTP rather than a packaged SDK. Missing for 10: official language SDKs (e.g. Python/TypeScript packages) for Computer, SDK documentation and examples, independent corroboration of SDK-based development.
